nodes.title: How to use
widgets_values:
## GTA VI style, Qwen-Image 2.1

Work left to right:

1. **Models**: Qwen-Image 2.1 base + Turbo, text encoder and VAE.
2. **Photo(s)**: load your photo(s).
3. **Clean-up** (optional, switch on by default): a fast Turbo edit puts each photo on a plain studio background
   with even light, so busy backgrounds don't leak into the illustration.
4. **Your settings**: pick a **Theme**; set each **person** (hair, outfit, accessory, pose, or `keep from photo`);
   choose a **group setup** and add your own specifics in `your_prompt`. The preview shows the exact prompt.
5. **Generate**: the base model draws the scene. Change the seed here for variations.

Grey "subgraph" nodes hide plumbing you rarely need; double-click one to open it.
RTX 3060 12 GB, 1248x832, 40 steps: ~26 s clean-up per photo, ~66-80 s generate (plus model swaps).

nodes.title: Clean-up encode (photo 1)
widgets_values: Replace the background of the image with a plain light-grey studio backdrop and relight the person with even, soft, diffused front studio light so their skin shows a clean, uniform tone. Keep their facial identity, expression, hairstyle, clothing and framing exactly as in the image.
